en.text: All value-added totals contributed by the firms equal the market value of all final goods and services.

zh.text: 所有廠商「增值」的總和與全部最終物品和服務的市值相等。

en.text: The market value of Flow B equals the market value of all final goods and services plus the market value of unsold goods.

zh.text: 流程 B 的市值等於全部最終物品和服務的市值與未售出貨物的市值之和。

en.text: The flow of final goods and services includes self-provided services.

zh.text: 最終物品和服務的流程包括向自己提供的服務。
